observations: Center of photo: a white plastic cube-shaped container (IBC tote) held in a steel cage frame, with a tap/valve visible at the base.
A label or sticker on the side of the tote is visible but text is too small/blurred to read.
Background shows several black cone-bottom overhead water tanks, one marked 'Geepee' (visible lettering).
Foreground shows a corrugated galvanized-metal cattle-trough style tank, cut off at the edge of frame.
No visible cracks, discoloration, or obvious damage on the IBC cage or plastic from this angle.
Ground is bare earth/yard, typical of an open-air tank dealer's lot, not a single private seller's home.

identity.kind: IBC tote water storage tank (cube tank in steel cage)
read_from: photo 0 (center item, cage and plastic tote visible)

claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: Photo shows the tote sitting empty/unused in what looks like a tank sales yard, not in active household use; cannot confirm prior use or condition from this image.

risks.risk: Tank may have previously held chemicals or non-potable liquids (common with reused IBC totes), making it unsafe for drinking water without verification.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the manufacturer's label/sticker on the tote showing original contents or food-grade marking.

risks.risk: Steel cage may be rusted or structurally weakened, which affects safe stacking/handling.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cage joints and base feet.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cage condition unknown/worst case (rusted)

risks.risk: Valve/tap may be cracked, stuck, or leaking.
risks.proof: Photo or short video of the valve being opened and water flowing without leaks.

risks.risk: Actual item for sale is ambiguous — multiple tanks (black overhead tanks, corrugated trough, IBC tote) appear in one yard photo; unclear which is listed.
risks.proof: A photo isolating only the item being sold, or seller confirmation in writing of which tank matches this listing.
risks.if_unproven: priced only for the IBC tote, since it is the clearest single subject in frame

risks.risk: Capacity of the tote (commonly 1000L but could vary) is not confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo showing the capacity marking on the tote's label or molded plastic.
risks.if_unproven: priced at smallest common IBC capacity assumption

proof_requests: Close-up of the tote's label/sticker (capacity, original contents, food-grade marking).
Photo/video of the valve opening and closing without leaks.
Confirmation of which specific tank in the photo is for sale, with a dedicated photo of just that item.
Photo of the cage base and joints for rust/damage check.
response.reason: The IBC tote water tank is clearly identifiable by type, so it can be priced at its worst case (unverified food-safety, valve, and cage condition) pending the listed proofs.
